moves.critique: Strongest feature: Carrier meets Evans’s burial objection by distinguishing corporeality from terrestrial location, then anchors the distinction in heavenly-Eden traditions, the Ascension of Isaiah, and Paul’s claimed revelatory gospel. Principal limitation: These parallels demonstrate conceptual availability, not that Corinthians understood burial cosmologically; identical reception vocabulary in Galatians and First Corinthians cannot establish identical revelatory acquisition, so “has to” exceeds linguistic evidence. Live burden: The reply preserves a non-earthly reading and contacts the physical-burial challenge, yet must show why Paul’s wording and audience assumptions favor that reading over ordinary transmission about an earthly death. Locked score: The frozen pattern places responsiveness at the peak and clarity next while evidential warrant sits lowest, with coherence, burden relevance, and charitable calibration in the middle because compatibility is established more convincingly than comparative probability.

Strongest feature: Carrier supplies an intelligible historicization mechanism: Plutarch’s account of public Osiris biographies, Mark’s insider-outsider teaching in chapter four, and the fig-tree episode collectively illustrate how outwardly historical narrative could carry initiatory allegory. Principal limitation: The argument transfers a practice through cults and centuries without evidence Mark shared Plutarch’s program, while the claim a gospel announces itself through one parable instruction outruns the literary clues. Live burden: The gospel-development case advances only if Carrier can distinguish deliberate esoteric composition from symbolic storytelling and explain why later literalization favors nonexistence over development around a remembered preacher. Locked score: The frozen dimensions place responsiveness highest, clarity and relevance upper-middle, coherence and evidential support lower, and charitable calibration lowest because talk of dupes, fiction, and pious lies hardens admitted uncertainty into accusation.
